Simple Crispy Fried Chicken

The Solo Chef Method: 350°F Oil | Egg Wash | 5-Minute Rest

Ingredients

  • 🍗 Chicken Pieces
  • 🌾 Flour
  • 🧂 Black Pepper
  • 🌿 Thyme
  • 🧄 Garlic
  • 🫚 Ginger
  • 🥚 Egg Wash
  • 🔥 Paprika
  • 💨 Smoked Paprika
  • 🧅 Onion Powder
  • 🍳 Cooking Oil

The Method

1. Heat the Oil: Bring oil to exactly 350°F.

2. Seasoning: Mix flour with all the dry spices listed above.

3. The Dip: Chicken goes in egg wash, then coat heavily in flour.

4. The Fry: Fry until golden brown and cooked through.

5. The Rest: Let it rest on a rack for 5 minutes before serving!
